introHtml: Half zip nursing scrubs offer a modern, professional look with the convenience of an easy-on, easy-off design. The zippered neckline provides quick ventilation and a polished appearance, making these scrubs a popular choice for healthcare facilities that value both function and style. Decorate the chest or back with your team logo using embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive, branded uniform.
